notes.title: Small Patch - April 27, 2025
notes.notes:
-Bunny Fish Day has ended
-Fixed Casino bug causing slots to have lower payouts
-Removed bundle turn in bars from Cove
-Added settings option to skip fight gear confirmation
-Added more eat point allocation amounts

notes.title: Event - Bunny Fish Day | April 20th - 27th
notes.notes:
Bunny Fish day is a small event lasting 1 week.

There are 6 eggs hidden within the different mechanics. Hints can be viewed in the event screen. After finding all 6 a trinket will be earned for FishClick.

Eggs will spawn every 5 minutes in the Hatchery tank. These can be eaten for eat exp and event currency.

notes.title: New farming feature & Clover Fish Day
notes.notes:
[b]Event - Clover Fish Day | March 17th - 24th[/b]
After reaching Fisher level 11, Clover Fish are able to be caught. These can be used to obtain clover seeds. 

[b]The Farm[/b]
When The Market reaches level 30, a seed pack will become available for purchase. This will unlock The Farm.
Seeds can be planted and will turn into currency based on the seed type.
Timer will continue to run while offline.
More seed packs will become available to use as farmer levels are gained.

notes.title: Small Patch - March 2, 2025
notes.notes:
-Fixed incorrect gear cost scaling
-Fixed sometimes not being able to select Pavilion boosts
-Hatchery upgrade max temporarily disabled due to various issues
-Various UI fixes

notes.title: Balance Patch - March 1, 2025
notes.notes:
-Collection currency tooltip now shows total earned
-Decreased exp gain from crate

-Rebalanced late game scaling, the following have been increased:
Moon piece bundle scaling
Fight gear pixel cost
Fight gear cost
Gear crate cost
Sky rod upgrade costs
Vectors needed for Heart Scale

These adjustments were made due to currency gains drastically outpacing upgrade costs.
A new mechanic for online/offline gains will be added soon to compensate for increased costs.

notes.title: Heart Fish Day & FishClick
notes.notes:
[b]Event - Heart Fish Day | February 14th - 21st[/b]
After reaching Fisher level 11, Heart Fish are able to be caught. These can be opened to obtain normal currency, or event currency.

There is also a chance to obtain a trinket used for FishClick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45401767/9c536d7514ec7e6c140d7a9dfe8220821a7fc5cb.png[/img]

[b]FishClick[/b]
A classic idle clicker that is supplemented by events, but will remain as a permanent feature.
